title: ReportNotes
description: Shape of packages/spec/report-notes.json: the standing statements every run's report prints and the notes it prints when its setup calls for them (PLAN M4.5, M7.5; ADR-062, ADR-073). Each is plain text, written once here and read by the web app and the report. Numbers only: no statement or note may state a verdict (CLAUDE.md).

version.description: Bumped whenever a statement's or note's text changes, so a report can say which wording it printed.

verificationUrl.description: Where a report's reader finds ClearFEA's verification cases, their references and tolerances (DECISIONS Positioning). Filled into statements as {verificationUrl}.

statements.description: What every report prints, whatever the run, in the order a report prints them (PLAN M7.5).

notes.description: Every note, in the order a report prints them.

title.description: Heading of the statement in the report.

text.description: The statement's paragraph. A name in braces is filled from the run when the report is made: {clearfea}, {deckFormat}, {calculix}, {gmsh} and {occt} from its recorded versions, {solver} from its frozen setup, and {verificationUrl} from this file.

source.description: Where the statement comes from, for people; not printed.

ReportNoteCondition.description: When a run's report carries the note. tiedBonds: the run's frozen setup ties at least one bond (a bond the user has not removed, ADR-059, ADR-060).

title.description: Heading of the note in the report.

source.description: Where the note's figures come from, for people; not printed.
